La Carta

From the grill, to the middle of the table

The parrillada is the main event — a sizzling tray of grilled meats that lands in the center of the table and feeds the whole group. Everything comes with the house chimichurri; just ask, like the regulars do.

Grupos y Celebraciones

Built for the big table

This is a house made for birthdays, family Sundays and match days — the TVs are on, the platters are built to share, and the staff treats a full table like family. Reserve ahead on weekends: regulars know to call before the dinner rush.

Nuestra Historia

More than 30 years of asado in Jackson Heights

For over three decades, one family has kept the fire lit on 37th Avenue. The specialty is the meat — parrillines loaded with cuts of beef, chorizo, morcilla and chinchulines — the sangría is house-made, and the chimichurri tastes, as one Uruguayan regular put it, exactly like her mother's.

«La esquina de la 84 y la 37 es la más uruguaya de todas gracias al Chivito d' Oro.» The house, in its own words
